text:
julie: T-minus 30 to start canary in eu-west. Quick warmdown checklist before we ramp — freeze enabled at 20:45 UTC. Who's watching runtime and cost?

sam: I'm oncall for runtime, watching p95 and cache-miss spikes. @sre-ops added.

maria: Release notes uploaded to console: https://console.internal/releases/rel-1.12.3 — callouts for embeddings behavior and quant flags.

julie: Short checklist (copy/paste):
```
- change window: 20:45-22:30 UTC (freeze ON)
- canary: 3 instances eu-west-1 (v1.12.3)
- traffic ramp plan: 5% -> 10% -> hold 45m -> stagger to 50%
- rollback: emergency-runbook v2, pin fallback v1.12.2
- monitors: p95 latency, 5xx rate, model-cost burn
- alerts: rapid-rollback if 5xx>0.5% or p95+100ms
```

devin: Re-confirming rollback steps: run `./tools/rollback --to v1.12.2 --force` and toggle `staged_cutover=false`. Keep deploy-bot in manual-unfreeze mode.

sre-ops: Alerts configured. I'll be watching dashboards and blackbox probes. If we see KV cache drop, call rollback immediately.

deploy-bot: pin set: v1.12.3 -> canary (3 nodes)
deploy-bot: canary started: 3 instances in eu-west-1 (ids: i-0a1, i-0b2, i-0c3)

lee: Holding cost caps on embedding endpoints, dropping batch size to 8 for canary requests.

maria: Note — quantization toggle remains OFF for this rollout (to avoid perf cliffs). Documented in release notes.

deploy-bot: canary health: 8m elapsed, 0.02% 5xx, p95 +18ms vs baseline. Traffic ramp to 10% initiated.

julie: Hold for 45m at 10% then proceed with staggered cutover if no regressions. Maintain freeze until final handoff.

sam: Acknowledged. I'll escalate to oncall infra if any infra alarms fire.

devin: If we need expedited rollback, @maria & @julie please sign the emergency-unfreeze in #release-control and I'll run rollback.

julie: Thanks team — keep responses short here. Post final go/no-go at end of hold window. :thumbsup:
